basic_profile.bio: A seasoned DJ from Chicago with a knack for spinning beats and an interest in haircare science. I've been in the music industry for over a decade, playing at clubs and private events. When I’m not mixing tracks, I’m experimenting with different haircare products to combat my hair thinning issues. I’m an early bird, usually online in the mornings and late evenings. Currently single and using my free time to explore new hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having no formal education in haircare, I've developed my knowledge through extensive self-teaching and community discussions. My expertise in DJing comes from years of hands-on experience and learning from other professionals in the industry.
